scope: OPTR v12 native capture, source partitions, teacher/gate/W_O/TP alignment, runtime-frame reconstruction, and independent-test selection boundary. Read-only production audit; concurrent offline replay edits are outside this report.

confirmed.evidence: Original whole-prompt seed tokens are rebuilt and checked against authenticated SHA256/count/optional lengths. Entire used source records are excluded before SHA-ordered train/validation/test partitioning. Different buckets receive deterministic different record offsets; remaining overlap within a split is not described as independent natural documents.

Capture observes post-normalization/RoPE Q/K, raw V, and the native BF16 attention output before gate multiplication. The QKV hook extracts per-Q-head interleaved gate logits and applies BF16 sigmoid. Pinned native fused split/normalization/RoPE writes gate logits without sigmoid; native Qwen subsequently applies sigmoid and multiplies attention output. No gate-offset or double-gating defect was confirmed.

Production trace geometry requires TP4/D256 and exactly one disjoint KV head per logical TP rank. Captured RowParallel W_O is authenticated by rank and reshaped from [hidden,hq*D] to [hq,hidden,D]. Actual token IDs, sampled positions, frames and complete source records must agree across ranks. Projection rounds gate multiplication to BF16 and sums Q-head/rank contributions before SSE.

Trace history contains prompt tokens plus generated_output_token_ids[:-1]; capture requests one extra output because the final sampled output has not been forwarded. Captured context/current end/padding shape reconstruct the same split-count formula as WorkspaceGeometry for supported local KV-head count one. Invalid gaps, a second live request, wrong positions, incomplete decode and cross-rank frame differences fail closed.

v12 selection receives train and validation only. The selected matrices and evidence are validated and checkpointed before independent-test replay. Resume authenticates the same lock and does not reselect. Independent-test regression raises and blocks publication. Reading all three authenticated split tensors into the layer container is not use of test for optimization.
confirmed.level: source_review; existing pipeline tests were not rerun in this audit command

known_coverage_limits_not_new_bugs.evidence: Native sampling is BS1, eager, prefix caching off, chunked prefill on and no speculative_config. It therefore does not certify mixed-batch, APC warm-prefill, MTP draft/accept/reject or graph executions. Existing physical snapshot, slot and GDN fixes are not changed by OPTR coefficient fitting.

With ideal full 16384-token chunks, current default 4K/32K/64K requests contribute respectively 16/24/40 sampled queries per split, including eight decode queries each: 80 total. Eight samples per long prefill frame do not cover all token errors. Packed, truncated and sometimes repeated source records are calibration inputs rather than natural long-dialogue accuracy evidence.

Captured teacher is pre-gate per-rank native attention, not actual post-W_O/HCCL output. Three CPU projection views model visible rounding, not closed native GEMM/reduction internals. Native hidden-state inputs also do not include drift caused by simultaneous changes in previous quantized layers. Passing finite local gates cannot guarantee full-model superiority over OSCAR.

recommendation: Preserve the existing authenticated raw capture and source policy for the present CPU preparation optimization. No new sampling bug was established that justifies forcing another NPU capture. Keep strict validation/test gates and implementation-specific fit cache invalidation; do not relabel sparse local evidence as model-quality acceptance.
